description: This file defines the InputManagerCompat interface and its nested InputDeviceListener interface, providing methods for managing input devices, handling input events, and compatibility across different Android API levels.

classes.name: InputManagerCompat
classes.description: Interface providing methods for input device management and event handling with compatibility support.

classes.name: InputManagerCompat.InputDeviceListener
classes.description: Interface for receiving notifications about input device addition, change, or removal.

classes.name: InputManagerCompat.Factory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of InputManagerCompat based on Android version.

methods.name: getInputDevice
methods.description: Retrieves information about an input device by its ID.

methods.name: getInputDeviceIds
methods.description: Returns an array of all input device IDs.

methods.name: registerInputDeviceListener
methods.description: Registers a listener for input device events.

methods.name: unregisterInputDeviceListener
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered input device listener.

methods.name: onGenericMotionEvent
methods.description: Passes motion events to the input manager for processing.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Informs the input manager to stop polling for disconnected devices.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Informs the input manager to start polling for disconnected devices.

methods.name: getInputManager
methods.description: Creates and returns a compatible InputManager instance based on Android version.
